charge_description: Misconduct and ill-behaviour towards his master - absented himself from his master's service without leave
raw_record: Summary conviction of John Humphrey apprentice to Harrison Waller of the township of Lythe shoemaker for misconduct and ill-behaviour towards his master.  In particular, on 1 November 1844 Humphrey absented himself from his master's service without leave, and continued absent for a week. Case heard at Whitby

defendants.other_details: Apprentice to Harrison Waller of the township of Lythe shoemaker
